question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH whsle_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        c.category_name,
        SUM("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY year, c.category_name
),
txn_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        c.category_name,
        SUM("qty_sold(kg)" * "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
      AND "sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY year, c.category_name
),
loss_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df lr
    JOIN veg_cat c ON lr.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.year,
    w.category_name,
    ROUND(w.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price - w.min_wholesale_price, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(l.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(l.avg_loss_rate * w.total_wholesale_price / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price - w.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM whsle_agg w
JOIN txn_agg t ON w.year = t.year AND w.category_name = t.category_name
JOIN loss_agg l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name
